brief: How we orchestrate 12 agents in production. Tools, patterns, gotchas.

slots.title: 1. Architecture, the foundation
slots.body: We run 12 specialized agents across three worker nodes using a central message bus. Each agent owns a single domain and publishes structured events.

slots.title: 2. Orchestrator, the conductor
slots.body: A state machine routes tasks using Redis Streams as the backbone. Agents pull jobs, not push, preventing cascade failures.

slots.title: 3. Protocol, the contract
slots.body: Every agent speaks JSON over gRPC with strict schemas. Shared context lives in PostgreSQL, not in-memory, for recovery.

slots.title: 4. Telemetry, the watchdog
slots.body: We trace every agent call with OpenTelemetry and pipe logs into Loki. Alerts fire when latency exceeds 2s.

slots.title: 5. Gotchas, the lessons
slots.body: Agent loops burn tokens fast. We cap retries at three and enforce a kill switch via circuit breakers.

slots.title: 6. Deploy, the pipeline
slots.body: Each agent deploys as a Docker container via GitHub Actions. We version prompts separately from code for safety.
